what: Control center: one read-only page for the arm, live and history, from one telemetry schema
why: Shows what the arm is doing, whether it is healthy and why it decided each thing: round trip against 850 ms, async or sync mode, speed against the 0.85 m/s clamp, the 320x176 frame the model saw, camera checks and every decision.
details: Runs with python3 -m control_center serve --demo. Tested against a simulated stream only; no writer in the sim loop or arm server yet.
